entry.title: Rain Chances Return to Roseburg as Cooler Weather Arrives Late This Week
entry.summary: Roseburg will see seasonable temperatures and mostly dry weather through Thursday before rain chances increase and cooler conditions arrive late in the week. Friday’s high is forecast near 66 degrees.

entry.title: Steamroller Print Brings the Umpqua River and Takelma Language to Life
entry.summary: A three-by-five-foot linocut of the Umpqua River printed with a steamroller at Umpqua Valley Arts uses augmented reality and audio recordings to introduce viewers to words spoken in Takelma.
